content.short: TON Proxy provides a secure and private network layer for TON sites and services, ensuring decentralized anonymity.
content.description: TON Proxy is a core component of The Open Network designed to provide a high level of privacy and anonymity for users and service providers. It functions as a decentralized network layer that hides IP addresses and encrypts traffic, similar to the Tor network but optimized for the TON ecosystem. TON Proxy allows for the creation of 'TON Sites' that are censorship-resistant and accessible without revealing the server's location. This service is essential for ensuring a truly private and decentralized internet experience on TON.
content.meta: Browse securely and privately with TON Proxy. Decentralized anonymity for the TON web on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
